metadata.question: Was it hotter in a 30 mile radius around Kabul, Afghanistan in February 2018 in comparison to February 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Collection: ERA5-Land daily aggregated 2 m air temperature (or ERA5 2 m if that fails) for reliable near-surface air temperature. - Dates: • Feb-2017: 2017-02-01 – 2017-02-28 • Feb-2018: 2018-02-01 – 2018-02-28 - Location: 30-mile (~48.3 km) radius around Kabul (34.5553, 69.2075). 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - ERA5-Land is gap-filled re-analysis; no cloud mask needed. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - Compute mean 2-m temperature for each February inside the circle. - Check collection sizes first; if 0 images → C1. - After reducing, if pixel count == 0 → C2. - If either mean is None/NaN or outside physically plausible range (say –80…80 °C) → C3. - Otherwise compare 2018 vs 2017: if 2018 mean > 2017 mean → A (Yes), else → B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') kabul = ee.Geometry.Point([69.2075, 34.5553]).buffer(48300) # 30 mi ≈ 48.3 km feb17 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR').select('temperature_2m').filterDate('2017-02-01', '2017-02-28') feb18 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR').select('temperature_2m').filterDate('2018-02-01', '2018-02-28') if feb17.size().getInfo() == 0 or feb18.size().getInfo() == 0: print("Feb2017 images:", feb17.size().getInfo(), "Feb2018 images:", feb18.size().getInfo()) print("C1") tmp17 = feb17.mean().multiply(0.01).subtract(273.15) # scale 0.01 & Kelvin→Celsius tmp18 = feb18.mean().multiply(0.01).subtract(273.15) count17 = tmp17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=kabul, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() count18 = tmp18.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=kabul, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() if count17 == 0 or count18 == 0: print("Valid pixels Feb2017:", count17, "Feb2018:", count18) print("C2") mean17 = tmp17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=kabul, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() mean18 = tmp18.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=kabul, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() if mean17 is None or mean18 is None: print("C3") print("Feb2017 mean °C: %.2f, Feb2018 mean °C: %.2f, pixels: %d/%d" % (mean17, mean18, count17, count18)) if mean18 > mean17: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

kabul = ee.Geometry.Point([69.2075, 34.5553]).buffer(48300)  # 30 mi ≈ 48.3 km
feb17 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR').select('temperature_2m').filterDate('2017-02-01', '2017-02-28')
feb18 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR').select('temperature_2m').filterDate('2018-02-01', '2018-02-28')

if feb17.size().getInfo() == 0 or feb18.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("Feb2017 images:", feb17.size().getInfo(), "Feb2018 images:", feb18.size().getInfo())
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

tmp17 = feb17.mean().multiply(0.01).subtract(273.15)  # scale 0.01 & Kelvin→Celsius
tmp18 = feb18.mean().multiply(0.01).subtract(273.15)

count17 = tmp17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=kabul, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
count18 = tmp18.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=kabul, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
if count17 == 0 or count18 == 0:
    print("Valid pixels Feb2017:", count17, "Feb2018:", count18)
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

mean17 = tmp17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=kabul, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
mean18 = tmp18.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=kabul, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()

if mean17 is None or mean18 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

print("Feb2017 mean °C: %.2f, Feb2018 mean °C: %.2f, pixels: %d/%d" % (mean17, mean18, count17, count18))

if mean18 > mean17:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
